design.quote: The Polypill for Heart Failure (POLY-HF) trial was a 2-center, open-label randomized clinical trial

population.value: Adults with HFrEF (LVEF ≤40%) not receiving target dose GDMT
population.quote: Eligible participants were adults with HFrEF (left ventricular ejection fraction [LVEF] ≤40%) not receiving target dose GDMT.

sample_size.quote: The study enrolled 212 participants (108 polypill, 104 usual care).

intervention.value: Once-daily overencapsulated polypill with multiple dose formulations (metoprolol succinate 25/50/100/150 mg, spironolactone 12.5 mg, empagliflozin 10 mg)
intervention.quote: Participants were randomized 1:1 to once-daily overencapsulated polypill with multiple dose formulations (metoprolol succinate 25/50/100/150 mg, spironolactone 12.5 mg, empagliflozin 10 mg)

comparator.value: Enhanced usual care with individual GDMTs coordinated with outpatient cardiology/primary care
comparator.quote: vs enhanced usual care with individual GDMTs coordinated with outpatient cardiology/primary care.

follow_up.quote: The primary endpoint was LVEF at 6 months adjusted for baseline
